identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3b, Prospective, Randomized, Open-label, Blind Evaluator (PROBE) Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of (LMW) Heparin/Edoxaban Versus Dalteparin in Venous Thromboembolism Associated With Cancer

armGroups.label: Edoxaban group
armGroups.description: After 5 days of low molecular weight heparin (LMWH), patients receive edoxaban treatment daily - tablet for oral use

armGroups.label: Dalteparin group
armGroups.description: Participants receive Dalteparin treatment daily -solution for subcutaneous injection

interventions.name: Edoxaban
interventions.description: After the 5 day treatment with LMWH, patients receive edoxaban 60 mg once daily (QD) as 2 × 30 mg tablets (or 1 x 30 mg tablet QD for patients requiring dose adjustment) for the remainder of the treatment period.

interventions.name: Dalteparin
interventions.description: Dalteparin was administered via subcutaneous injection at a dose of 200 IU/kg (maximum daily dose 18,000 IU) for 30 days, and at a dose of 150 IU/kg from Day 31 to the end of treatment.

interventions.name: Low molecular weight heparin
interventions.description: Therapeutic doses of subcutaneous LMWH were administered for at least 5 days (to patients in the edoxaban group); this 5-day period may have included the pre-randomization LMWH (if applicable). The choice of parenteral LMWH was up to the treating physician.
